package.base_sha_note: The base_sha field reflects the current PR base after the rebase that picked up Phase 51G-2, 51G-3, and 51H-1. It will become stale on the next rebase and is maintained as a snapshot, not as a live reference. For the live base, see origin/main.

claim_level_definitions.external_claim_allowed: Project-internal flag indicating whether the project is willing to make a written statement to an outside party that the area behaves as documented. NOT a lender/bank/audit/regulatory/certification/SaaS claim.
claim_level_definitions.pilot_claim_allowed: Project-internal flag indicating whether the area is ready for controlled-pilot exposure to a real human user. NOT a production claim.

global_notes: No area in this matrix currently has external_claim_allowed: true. The project does not make external claims at this time.
Areas with pilot_claim_allowed: true are candidates for the controlled pilot (B7). They are not yet ready for any external claim.
AREA-001 (TUHO) and AREA-002 (Oborovo) are the two narrow-scope targets for promotion to approved_for_narrow_scope after B1 review and a controlled pilot.
AREA-003 (generic solar) and AREA-004 (generic wind) are explicitly exploratory and are not promoted to pilot or external claim by the existence of Oborovo / TUHO as specific projects.
AREA-007 (Tax) is too broad for a blanket pilot claim; sub-area decomposition (CIT, LCF, ATAD, WHT, depreciation, cash-tax timing) is required before any tax sub-area enters pilot scope.
AREA-013 (scenario persistence) and AREA-015 (Phase 51G-1) reflect pre-51G-2 behavior; pin refresh and forward-compatibility decision are pending after 51G-2/51G-3/51H-1.
AREA-014 (Phase 51F guardrails) is regression protection, not external validation, and is not promoted to external_claim_allowed by being green. It is also not a user-facing pilot feature.
AREA-015 (Phase 51G-1) is characterization only; it is superseded for production surface area by Phase 51G-2/51G-3/51H-1 (see AREA-019).
AREA-016 (B1 external review package) is documentation and evidence preparation, not external validation. The package is in place; no third-party review has been performed.
AREA-019 covers Phase 51G-2 (extraction), 51G-3 (fix), and 51H-1 (scenario state characterization). All are Agent A owned and not modified by this PR.
This matrix is a working artifact. Demotions to weaker categories are encouraged when evidence is found insufficient. See model_evidence_taxonomy.md §6 for the demotion procedure.
